name: publication
title: Publishing a value through a flag
summary: A writer stores a value and then raises a flag; a reader waits for the flag and reads the value, many times over. The page counts the trials where the flag arrived before the value, under each ordering.

controls.name: ordering
controls.label: Ordering
controls.hint: volatile: a volatile flag, no ordering asked for. relaxed: an atomic flag with memory_order_relaxed. release-acquire: the store is a release, the load an acquire. seq_cst: both sequentially consistent.

results.name: stale
results.label: Stale reads
results.what: trials where the reader saw the flag raised but read the previous trial's value

results.name: elapsed
results.label: Elapsed
results.what: all trials, from the start barrier opening to the last worker finishing

trace.what: a model where the writer's two stores may become visible in either order unless the flag's store is a release
